Maneuvering

Chế Độ Ổn Định Tốc Độ

Autopilot setting that dampens oscillations by keeping rate of turn constant once a target value is reached during manoeuvre.

Why it matters

Where does this definition come from?

This definition is sourced from IMO SMCP, STCW Convention, SOLAS, COLREG and published by Protermify Maritime as a static maritime reference page.

Definition

Autopilot setting that dampens oscillations by keeping rate of turn constant once a target value is reached during manoeuvre.

Operational example

Helm: Engage rate stabilization mode at two degrees per minute to smooth spiral turn into basin entrance under quartering wind.

Localized term
